name: xray_spine_lumbar
description: Order a lumbar spine X-ray to evaluate alignment, disc space narrowing, spondylolisthesis, fractures, and degenerative changes.

weight_bearing.description: Whether weight-bearing views are required for alignment assessment

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., low back pain, radiculopathy, trauma)

when_to_use: chronic or acute low back pain initial workup
assessment of lumbar alignment and disc degeneration
trauma screening for lumbar burst or compression fractures

examples.query: Patient with chronic low back pain and bilateral leg pain worse with extension
